name: Aloe Vera
hook: Mushy aloe leaves? Your windowsill succulent is drowning.

steps.title: Your sunniest window
steps.tip: A south or west window is ideal, but shield it from harsh midday sun.

steps.title: Soak, then let dry
steps.tip: Water deeply only when the soil is fully dry. Give it very little water in winter.

steps.title: Gritty cactus mix
steps.tip: Use cactus mix in a terracotta pot with a drainage hole so the roots dry out fast.

steps.title: Keep it frost-free
steps.tip: It's fine on a balcony in summer, but bring it in before nights drop below 13°C.

steps.title: Separate the baby plants
steps.tip: Gently pull off the baby plants that have their own roots, and pot them in cactus mix.

outro: Lots of sun, fast drainage, and let it dry out between waterings.
